alt: Exercise 5 is worth 8 marks: about 120 words, such as an email, written in response to prompts or pictures for a set purpose, format and audience. All five writing objectives, W1 to W5, are tested.
caption: A short functional text: purpose, format and audience are set for you.

after: ## Decoding the task: purpose, format, audience
alt: Three columns: purpose (such as دعوت دینا, شکریہ ادا کرنا, شکایت کرنا) decides the content; format (ای میل, خط, پیغام) decides opening, closing and layout; audience (دوست to پرنسپل) decides the register. Every prompt must then be covered.
caption: Purpose sets the content, format the layout, audience the register.

after: ## Register: تم or آپ, and keeping to it
alt: A table of informal and formal Urdu letter and email phrases: address تم or آپ, openings پیارے احمد، or محترم پرنسپل صاحب، greetings, requests, thanks, closing lines and sign-offs such as تمہارا دوست، or والسلام،.
caption: The audience decides the register, from the first word to the sign-off.

after: ## Register: تم or آپ, and keeping to it
alt: Informal تم takes forms such as ہو، کرو، آؤ، تمہارا; formal آپ takes ہیں، کیجیے، آئیے، آپ کا. Mixing them, as in آپ آؤ, is the commonest error; آپ آئیے is correct. A boy writes لکھ رہا ہوں and a girl لکھ رہی ہوں.
caption: Choose تم or آپ once, then check every verb against it.

alt: A word budget for about 120 words: 10-15 for the opening and greeting, about 30 for each of three prompts, and 10-15 for the closing and sign-off. Each prompt paragraph gives a statement, a detail or reason, and a feeling or comment, and the prompts invite past, present and future or conditional (اگر… تو…).
caption: About 30 words per prompt, each with a statement, a reason and a comment.

alt: The model email to Salman laid out part by part: opening پیارے سلمان، and a greeting, three short paragraphs for the three prompts (the photography club, last week's trip to the old fort, and the invitation to the exhibition), a closing request جلدی جواب دینا۔ and the sign-off تمہارا دوست، بلال.
caption: Greeting, one paragraph per prompt, closing line, sign-off: all in the تم register.

alt: A 15-minute plan: 2 minutes to plan, 10 to write and 3 to check, followed by a six-point checklist on prompts, register, format, gender agreement, نے and noun agreement. Below, نیا کتاب is corrected to نئی کتاب and میں نے کتاب خریدا to میں نے کتاب خریدی.
caption: Plan briefly, write, then check prompts, register and agreement.
